e.title: AWS Fraud Graph Detection
e.summary: AWS 官方保险欺诈图检测样例：图数据库 + 共谋网络检测（可跑）
e.body: AWS 官方样例（sample-fraud-detection-on-aws）的 insurance-fraud/graph-based-detection：用图数据库构建保险欺诈关系网络、检测共谋团伙。对 RIAA：欺诈检测的图方法落地——「[[fraud-detection]] 从单笔规则走向关系网络」的工程样例；与 [[shift-technology]]（商用欺诈平台）、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]（开源 demo）构成欺诈检测方法谱系；培训课「图分析反欺诈」演示。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：AWS 官方仓库 + graph-based-detection 目录确认，未实测
e.summary_en: AWS official insurance-fraud graph detection sample: graph database + collusion network detection (runnable)
e.summary_hk: AWS 官方保險欺詐圖檢測樣例：圖數據庫 + 共謀網絡檢測（可跑）
e.body_en: The AWS official sample (sample-fraud-detection-on-aws) insurance-fraud/graph-based-detection: builds an insurance-fraud relationship network with a graph database to detect collusion rings. For RIAA: a graph-method implementation of fraud detection — the engineering sample of "fraud detection from single-rule to relationship-network"; with [[shift-technology]] (commercial platform) and [[claims-fraud-guardian]] (open demo) it forms a fraud-detection method spectrum; training sessions can demo graph-based anti-fraud.
e.body_hk: AWS 官方樣例（sample-fraud-detection-on-aws）的 insurance-fraud/graph-based-detection：用圖數據庫構建保險欺詐關係網絡、檢測共謀團夥。對 RIAA：欺詐檢測的圖方法落地——「[[fraud-detection]] 從單筆規則走向關係網絡」的工程樣例；與 [[shift-technology]]（商用欺詐平台）、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]（開源 demo）構成欺詐檢測方法譜系；培訓課「圖分析反欺詐」演示。
